players.bio: Amourricho Jahvairo Déshauntino van Axel Dongen (born 29 September 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Eredivisie club Heerenveen, on loan from Ajax Born in Almere, Van Axel Dongen played youth football for Zeeburgia and OSV Amsterdam before joining the youth academy of Ajax. He signed his first professional contract with the club in September 2020.

Anass Bouziane (born 22 December 2006) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Volendam. Career Born in Zaandam, Bouziane began his youth career with OFC, later captained Fortuna Wormerveer's under‑16s, and joined the Volendam academy in 2022.
Andries Noppert (born 7 April 1994) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Heerenveen as a goalkeeper.

Dirk Wanner Proper (born 24 February 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club NEC. Club career Born in Elst, Gelderland, Proper started playing football at amateur club SV Spero before joining the NEC youth academy at the age of nine, where he was quickly regarded as one of the club's most promising prospects.
Dylan Vente (born 9 May 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for club Heerenveen. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Suriname national team.

Hristiyan Ivaylov Petrov (Bulgarian: Християн Ивайлов Петров; born 24 June 2002) is a Bulgarian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie club Heerenveen and the Bulgaria national team.

Jacob Bennedsen Trenskow (born 26 November 2000) is a Danish footballer who plays as a forward for Dutch Eredivisie club Heerenveen. Having been a youth player in Aarhus GF, Trenskow started his senior career with AC Horsens in 2020. He was first given a contract up until the winter break.

Lanroy Machine (born 13 October 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Angers. Career Machine grew up in the Bellecroix neighborhood of Metz before joining the youth academy of the local professional club FC Metz at the age of 9. In 2024, he signed for the reserve team of Angers after contractual disagreements with Metz.

Luca Oyen (born 14 March 2003) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Genk. Club career Oyen made his professional debut with Genk in a 2–1 Belgian First Division A win over Zulte Waregem. On 16 December 2021 he scored his first goal for Genk in a 4–2 win over Chareloi. International career Oyen was born in England to Belgian parents.

Luuk Brouwers (born 3 May 1998) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Heerenveen. Club career Brouwers made his professional debut in the Eerste Divisie for FC Den Bosch on 10 April 2015 in a game against Jong PSV. On 5 February 2020, Brouwers signed a three-year contract effective from 30 June 2020 with Go Ahead Eagles.

Maas Willemsen (born 29 April 2003 in Zutphen) is a Dutch footballer who plays as a defender. In 2025, he exchanged De Graafschap for sc Heerenveen. Career Willemsen started playing football at SV Harfsen. After which he made the switch to the youth academy of FC Twente. In 2014, he made the switch to the youth academy of De Graafschap.
Marcus Linday (born 2 June 2003) is a Swedish footballer who plays as a midfielder for Dutch Eredivisie club Heerenveen.

Maxence Rivera (born 30 May 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a winger for Heerenveen Professional career Rivera began playing football at the youth academy of Bourgoin-Jallieu, and joined the youth academy of Saint-Étienne in 2015. On 3 January 2020, he signed his first professional contract with Saint-Étienne.

Mees Victor Joseph Hilgers (born 13 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Eredivisie side Twente. Born in the Netherlands, he represents the Indonesia national team. On 6 December 2018, Hilgers signed his first professional contract with FC Twente. He made his professional debut with Twente in a 2–1 Eredivisie win over AFC Ajax on 5 December 2020.
Oliver Johansen Braude (born 21 February 2004) is a Norwegian footballer who plays as a defender for Heerenveen.

Ringo Meerveld (born 21 December 2002) is a Dutch professional footballer who currently plays as a midfielder for SC Heerenveen. Club career Born in 's-Hertogenbosch, Ringo Meerveld began his football career as a youth player at FC Den Bosch. He signed a three-year contract with the club on 2 August 2019. Meerveld made his debut for FC Den Bosch on 12 August 2019 in a 2–2 draw against Jong PSV.
Roberts Uldriķis (born 3 April 1998) is a Latvian professional footballer who plays as a forward.
Robin Veldman (born 24 December 1985) is a Dutch football manager who is the manager of SC Heerenveen in the Eredivisie.
Sam Kersten (born 30 January 1998) is a Dutch professional football player who plays for Eredivisie club Heerenveen.
Vasilios Zagaritis (born 4 May 2001) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Dutch club Sc Heerenveen.
